explication: P3C implements Alibaba Java coding-guideline checks through PMD and exposes them in Eclipse and IntelliJ IDEA. The main workflow is selecting or committing code, running inspections, then reviewing violations and applying available fixes. PMD supplies the shared rule engine; IDE-specific inspection rules complement its catalog. The graph includes documented capabilities and relationships visible in excerpts or the source index; unsampled wiring is omitted rather than inferred.
